sources.title: PDF MONTE: Methylation-based Observation Normalization and Tumor purity ...
sources.snippet: MONTE learns probe-wise relationships between observed methylation and tumor purity using a stabilized linear model with empirical Bayes variance moderation and infers purity in new samples via signal-to-noise weighted aggregation of probe-level effects, without requiring matched normal samples or predefined probe sets.
